source.note_posted_date_basis: note title suffix 261123 interpreted as 2026-11-23 Asia/Shanghai; unverified against platform timestamp
source.source_url_basis: derived from note_id; xsec_token omitted from public export
source.post_likes_basis: value shown on the user profile note card at collection time

capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in browser (huashu-chrome CDP bridge; transient NO_EXTENSION warning cleared on retry); card metadata extracted from DOM (section.note-item); cover image downloaded with Referer header via curl after urllib reset in prior runs.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos (640x295 -> 1920x885), then cropped into left/right halves and per-row/column slices at 2x-9x for glyph disambiguation
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table. Ambiguous glyphs (author 木森火焱(第4字火叠结构), title 枇杷盈盈(首二字木旁)) flagged medium with per-item ocr_notes; no glyph resolved by guessing. Two semantically odd qualitative labels ('好评多性转','好多坏少') transcribed verbatim.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes/danping/comment_status are cover-image labels; '喜欢' and '弹评' are numeric counts as printed, '评论现状' is a qualitative tag.
parsing.tags_normalization: original '.' separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability

analysis_boundary: Single-cover OCR of a third-party public ranking screenshot. Book/author names and counts are best-effort transcription from an embedded low-resolution table, not verified against the original platform; several glyphs flagged medium remain ambiguous. Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
